lines.en: When you are discharged from hospital, let's play together.

lines.py: Nǐ xiànzài shāngkǒu hái téng ma?
Háishì yǒu yìdiǎnr, dànshì hǎo duō le.
lines.zh: 还是有一点儿，但是好多了。
lines.en: It's still a little bit, but much better.

lines.py: Xiànzài nǐ néng xià chuáng zǒuzou ma?
lines.rw: Ubu se ushobora kubyuka ukagendagenda hano hafi?
lines.en: Can you get out of bed now and walk around?

lines.py: Hái bù néng, shāngkǒu hái hěn tòng.
lines.en: Not yet, the wound is still painful.

lines.py: Nǐ chūyuàn de shíhou tíqián gàosu wǒ, wǒ lái jiē nǐ.
lines.zh: 你出院的时候提前告诉我，我来接你。
lines.rw: Uzambwire mbere yo kuva mu bitaro nzaze kugufata.
lines.en: Tell me in advance when you leave the hospital, I will pick you up.

lines.py: Zǎoshang jǐ diǎn sòng háizi dào yòuéryuán?
lines.zh: 早上几点送孩子到幼儿园？
lines.rw: Ni ryari nagombye gutwara abana ku ishuri ry’ikiburamwaka buri gitondo?
lines.en: What time should i take the children to kindergarten every morning?

lines.rw: Babageza ku ishuri mbere ya saa mbiri.
lines.en: They are taken to the kindergarten before eight.

lines.py: Yǒu, yě kěyǐ jiāzhǎng zìjǐ lái jiēsòng.
lines.zh: 有，也可以家长自己来接送。
lines.rw: Yego, ariko ababyeyi nabo bashobora kuza kubafata.
lines.en: Yes, parents can also pick them up.

lines.rw: Amafaranga y’ishuri ni angahe ku gihembwe?
lines.en: How much is the tuition fee for one semester?

lines.rw: Ni amafaranga ibihumbi ijana ku gihembwe.

lines.py: Yí ge bān yǒu jǐ wèi lǎoshī?
lines.en: How many teachers are there in a class?

lines.py: Háizi yìbān jǐ suì shàng yòuéryuán?
lines.zh: 孩子一般几岁上幼儿园？
lines.rw: Ubusanzwe abana batangira ishuri ry’inshuke ku myaka ingahe?
lines.en: How old are children usually going to kindergarten?

lines.py: Yí ge bān dàgài yǒu duōshao háizi?
lines.zh: 一个班大概有多少孩子？
lines.en: How many children are there in a class?

lines.py: Dàgài yǒu èrshí ge háizi ba.
Wǒ néng xiān cānguān yíxià ma?
Lǎoshī, Lù Sīchéng bìng le. Tā ràng wǒ gēn nín shuō yíxià.
lines.zh: 老师，陆思成病了。他让我跟您说一下。
lines.rw: Mwarimu, Lu Sicheng ararwaye. Yansabye kubikumenyesha.
lines.en: Teacher, Lu Sicheng is sick. He asked me to let you know.

lines.py: Lú Jié, zhè ge zì zěnme dú?
lines.rw: Lu Jie, iyi nyuguti bayisoma gute?
lines.en: Lu Jie, how do you read this character?

lines.py: Sū Lì, zhè ge zì shì shénme yìsi?
lines.zh: 苏丽，这个字是什么意思？
lines.en: Suli, what does this character mean?
Teacher, please say it a bit more slowly.

lines.py: Lǎoshī, qǐng nín zài shuō yí biàn.
lines.en: Teacher, could you say it again?

lines.py: Lǎoshī, wǒ kěyǐ dài shū jìnqu ma?
lines.zh: 老师，我可以带书进去吗？
lines.en: Teacher, may I take the book in?

lines.py: Lǎoshī, wǒ xiǎng jiè zhè běn shū.
lines.en: Teacher, I’d like to borrow this book.

lines.py: Lǎoshī, zuì duō kěyǐ jiè jǐ běn?
lines.rw: Mwarimu, ibitabo nshobora gutira ni bingahe?
lines.en: Teacher, how many books can I borrow at most?

lines.py: Yì běn shū néng jiè duōcháng shíjiān?
lines.en: How long can a book be kept？

lines.py: Xuésheng zhǐ néng jiè yí ge yuè.
lines.rw: Abanyeshuri bemerewe kugumana ibitabo ukwezi kumwe gusa.
lines.en: Students can only keep them for one month.

lines.py: Dào qī hái kěyǐ xùjiè ma?
lines.rw: Nshobora kongera kugitira igihe cyagenwe kirangiye?
lines.en: Can I renew it when it is due?

lines.rw: Iyo igihe cyo gutirura cyarenze bigenda bite?

lines.py: Guòqī yào jiāo fákuǎn, suóyǐ zuìhǎo dàoqī jiù huán.
lines.zh: 过期要交罚款，所以最好到期就还。
lines.rw: Hishyurwa amande y’ubukererwe,niyo mpamvu byaba byiza kugitirura ku gihe.
lines.en: There will be a fine as overdue payment, so it’s better to return it back when it’s due.

lines.py: Nǐ shì nǎ ge xì de?

lines.rw: Mbarizwa mu gashami k’ururimi rw’Igishinwa n’Ubuvanganzo.
lines.en: I’m a from Department of Chinese Language and Literature.
Teaching Chinese as a Second language.

lines.py: Nǐ xǐhuan nǐ de zhuānyè ma?
Nǐmen de zhuānyè kè nán bu nán?
lines.rw: Ese amasomo yawe yo mu cyiciro arakomeye cyangwa aroroshye?
lines.en: Are your major courses difficult or not?

lines.py: Shàngcì kǎoshì, nǐmen dōu jígé le ma?
lines.zh: 上次考试，你们都及格了吗？
lines.en: Did your class pass the last exam?

lines.py: Yǒu liǎng ge rén méi jígé.
Kǎoshì bù jígé, kěyǐ bǔkǎo ma?
lines.zh: 考试不及格，可以补考吗？
lines.rw: Iyo utsinzwe ikizame, ushobora kongera kugisubiramo?
lines.en: If you fail the exam, can you make it up?
You can take a make-up exam for free.

lines.py: Nín hǎo! Wǒ xiǎng bàomíng xuéxí Hànyǔ.
lines.zh: 您好！我想报名学习汉语。
lines.rw: Muraho! Ndashaka kwiyandikisha kugirango nige Igishinwa.
lines.en: Hello! I want to sign up to learn Chinese.

lines.py: Nín hǎo! Huānyíng nín! Qǐng zuò.
lines.en: Hello! Welcome! Have a sit please.

lines.py: Qǐngwèn, yì xuéqī de xuéfèi shì duōshǎo?
lines.zh: 请问，一学期的学费是多少？
lines.en: What is the tuition fee for one semester?
May I ask, when does the semester began?

lines.rw: Abanyeshuri bagombye kuba bariyandikishije ku itariki ya mbere Nzeli.
lines.en: (Students are supposed to) Register on Sep.1st.

lines.py: Zhè shì bàomíng dēngjì biǎo, qǐng tián yíxià.
lines.zh: 这是报名登记表，请填一下。
lines.en: This is the registration form, please fill it out.

lines.py: Xuéguò. Wǒ huì shuō yìdiǎnr Hànyǔ.
lines.zh: 学过。我会说一点儿汉语。
lines.rw: Nigeze kucyiga mbere. Nshobora kuvuga Igishinwa gake.
lines.en: I had learned it before. I can speak a little Chinese.

lines.py: Nín de Hànyǔ shì zài nǎlǐ xuéxí de?
lines.zh: 您的汉语是在哪里学习的？

lines.py: Shì de, wǒ fēicháng xǐhuan tā de fēnggé.
lines.zh: 是的，我非常喜欢它的风格。

lines.en: What would you like to try?
I would like to drink juice.

lines.py: Xīhóngshì zhī bú cuò, xiǎng bu xiǎng shìshi?
lines.zh: 西红柿汁不错，想不想试试？
lines.rw: Umutobe w’inyanya ni mwiza, urashaka kuwugerageza?
lines.en: Tomato juice is good, would you like to try it?

lines.py: Nǐ yào dà bēi de háishì xiǎo bēi de?
lines.zh: 你要大杯的还是小杯的？
lines.rw: Urashaka ko nguha inini cyangwa intoya?
lines.en: Do you want a big one or a small one?

lines.py: Nǐ xiǎng qù wàibiān zuò yíhuìr ma?
lines.zh: 你想去外边坐一会儿吗？
lines.rw: Urabivugaho iki kwicara hanze ku kazuba gake?
lines.en: How about sit outside for a little white?

lines.py: Shì de, wǒ xiǎng qù wàibiān kànkan.
lines.rw: Nibyo rwose. Ndashaka kureba neza hanze.
lines.en: Sure. I would like to visit outside.

lines.py: Zuì zǎo de yì chǎng shì xiàwǔ sì diǎn.
lines.zh: 最早的一场是下午四点。
lines.rw: Isaha yo kwerekana filime ya hafi ni sakumi nyuma ya sasita..
lines.en: The earliest show is at 4 in the afternoon.

lines.py: Nǐ juéde zhè bù piānzi zěnmeyàng?
lines.zh: 你觉得这部片子怎么样？
lines.rw: Wumva umeze ute kuri iyi film?
lines.en: How do you feel about this film?

lines.py: Tài gǎnrén le, wǒ dōu kū le.
lines.rw: Yarimo amarangamutima menshi ku buryo nasakuje.
lines.en: It was so touching that I cried.
How do you feel about painting?

lines.py: Nǐ xǐhuan nán yī hào ma?
Mǎmahūhu, wǒ gèng xǐhuan nán èr hào.
lines.zh: 马马虎虎，我更喜欢男二号。
lines.rw: Ntabwo ari kibi ariko mpisemo iki gishushanyije umugabo wa kabiri.
lines.en: Not bad, but I prefer male number two.

lines.py: Wǒ yóu diǎn kě le. Nǎlǐ kěyǐ mǎi shuǐ?
lines.zh: 我有点渴了。哪里可以买水？
lines.rw: Ndumva mfite inyota. Ni hehe nshobora kugura amazi?
lines.en: I am a little thirsty. Where can I buy water?

lines.py: Mén kǒu yǒu yí gè xiǎomàibù.
lines.en: There is a shop at the gate.

lines.py: Wǒmen yìqǐ chàng zhè shǒu gē ba.
Duìbuqǐ, wǒ bú huì chàng zhè shǒu gē.
lines.zh: 对不起，我不会唱这首歌。
lines.en: Sorry, I can't sing this song.

lines.py: Qǐngwèn sān hào fángjiān zài nǎr?
lines.en: Excuse me, where is booth No.3?

lines.py: Zhí zǒu, dì èr jiān jiù shì.
lines.rw: Komeza imbere, ni ku cyumba cya kabiri.

lines.py: Nǐ zuì xǐhuan de gēshǒu shì shuí?
Wǒ zuì xǐhuan de gēshǒu shì Tàilè.
lines.zh: 我最喜欢的歌手是泰勒。

lines.py: Nǐ huì chàng Fǎyǔ gē ma?
lines.rw: Ushobora kuririmba indirimbo ziri mu Gifaransa?

lines.py: Nǐ tīng guo zhè shǒu gē ma?
Shì de, zhè shǒu gē hěn liúxíng.
lines.en: Yes, his song is very popular.

lines.py: Nǐ píngshí xǐhuan tīng shénme yīnyuè?
lines.zh: 你平时喜欢听什么音乐？

lines.py: Zhè shǒu gē shì shuí diǎn de?
Nǐ de piào shì zài nǎr mǎi de?
lines.en: Where did you by the ticket?

lines.py: Wǒ shì zài wǎngshang dìng de.

lines.rw: Uvuye aha inzu y’ibirori iri kure?
lines.en: Is the theater far from here?

lines.py: Bù yuǎn, zǒu shíwǔ fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
lines.zh: 不远，走十五分钟就到了。
lines.rw: Ntabwo ari kure, ni urugendo rw'iminota itanu gusa.
lines.en: Not far, Just five minutes walk.

lines.py: Qǐngwèn zhè shì dì jǐ pái?
lines.en: Excuse me, which row is it?

lines.py: Wǒ néng gēn nín héyǐng ma?
lines.en: Could I take a picture with you?

lines.py: Nǐ juéde zhè chǎng yǎnchū zěnmeyàng?
lines.zh: 你觉得这场演出怎么样？
lines.en: How do you think about this show?

lines.py: Zhè chǎng yǎnchū yào yǎn duōjiǔ?
lines.rw: Iki gitaramo kiramara igihe kingana iki?
lines.en: How long will this show last?

lines.py: Wǒmen de chē háiyǒu duōjiǔ dào?
lines.en: How long will our car arrive?

lines.py: Kěyǐ, dàn qǐng búyào shǐyòng shǎngguāngdēng.
lines.zh: 可以，但请不要使用闪光灯。
lines.en: Ok, but please do not use a flash.
Yes, but it needs to pay.

lines.py: Zuìjìn háiyǒu shénme xīn zhǎnlǎn ma?
lines.zh: 最近还有什么新展览吗？

lines.rw: Hari imurika ku bashyitsi bose mu cyumweru gitaha.
lines.en: There is a customs exhibition next week.

lines.rw: Inzu ndangamurage yanyu iri kuri murandasi?
lines.en: Does your museum have a website?

lines.py: Yǒu de, zài Gǔgē shang sōusuǒ wǒmen bówùguǎn de míngzi jiù néng zhǎo dào.
lines.zh: 有的，在谷歌上搜索我们博物馆的名字就能找到。
lines.rw: Yego, ushobora kuyibona ushakiye izina ry’inzu ndangamurage yacu kuri murandasi ya Google.
lines.en: Yes, you can find it by searching for the name of our museum on Google.

lines.py: Cānguān bówùguǎn yào mǎi piào ma?
lines.rw: Ngomba kugura itike kugira ngo mbashe gusura inzu ndangamurage?
lines.en: Do I have to buy a ticket to visit the museum?

lines.py: Shì de, měi ge rén sānshí Měiyuán.
lines.rw: Yego, umuntu umwe ni amadorari mirongo itatu.

lines.py: Wǒ gèzi bù gāo, kěshì wǒ xǐhuān dǎ lánqiú.
lines.zh: 我个子不高，可是我喜欢打篮球。
lines.rw: Ntabwo ndi muremure, ariko nkunda gukina basketball.
lines.en: I’m not tall but I like to play basketball.

lines.py: Wǒ xiǎng xué dǎ wǎngqiú, nǐ jiāojiao wǒ ba!
lines.zh: 我想学打网球，你教教我吧！
lines.rw: Ndashaka kwiga gukina tenisi. Ushobora kubinyigisha?
lines.en: I want to learn playing tennis. Can you teach me?

lines.py: Wǒ gēge shì wǎngqiú jiàoliàn, tā kěyǐ jiāo nǐ.
lines.zh: 我哥哥是网球教练，他可以教你。
lines.rw: Mukuru wanjye ni umutoza wa tenisi, ashobora kukwigisha.
lines.en: My elder brother is a tennis coach, he can teach you.

lines.py: Nǐ zhīdào ma? Wǒ dìdì shì zúqiú yùndòngyuán.
lines.zh: 你知道吗？我弟弟是足球运动员。
lines.rw: Uzi n’ikindi? Murumuna wanjye ni umukinnyi w’umupira w’amaguru.
lines.en: Do you know? My younger brother is a football player.

lines.py: Guàibùdé tā zúqiú tī de nàme hǎo.
lines.zh: 怪不得他足球踢得那么好。
lines.rw: Nta gitangaza! Akina neza umupira w’amaguru.
lines.en: No wonder he is so good at playing football.

lines.py: Wǒmen zhōumò yìqǐ qù páshān ba.
lines.zh: 我们周末一起去爬山吧。
lines.rw: Reka tuzajyane kuzamuka umusozi muri wikendi.
lines.en: Let’s climb the hill this weekend.

lines.py: Zuìjìn gōngzuò hěn máng, wǒmen zài yuē shíjiān ba.
lines.zh: 最近工作很忙，我们再约时间吧。
lines.rw: Vuba aha nari mfite akazi kenshi cyane. Reka tuzahure ikindi gihe.
lines.en: I have been busy recently. Let’s meet some other time.

lines.py: Bú huì, yìdiǎnr jīchǔ dōu méiyǒu.
lines.zh: 不会，一点儿基础都没有。
lines.en: I can’t swim. I have no experience at all.

lines.py: Nǐ liàn le duō jiǔ le?
lines.en: How long have you been practicing?
I have been practicing Taichi for many years.

lines.py: Jīntiān wǎnshàng yǒu zúqiú bǐsài, women yìqǐ qù kàn ba.
lines.zh: 今天晚上有足球比赛，我们一起去看吧。
lines.rw: Ku mugoroba hari umukino w’umupira w’amaguru, reka tujyane kuwureba.
lines.en: There is a football match tonight, let’s watch it.

lines.py: Hǎo de. Shéi hé shéi bǐ?
lines.rw: Yego. Ni ayahe makipe abiri akina?
lines.en: Ok. Which two teams are playing?

lines.py: Bāxī hé Agēntíng. Nǐ xīwàng shéi yíng?
lines.zh: 巴西和阿根廷。你希望谁赢？
lines.rw: Brazil na Argentina. Ni iyihe kipe ushaka ko itsinda?
lines.en: Brazil and Argentina. Which team do you want to win?

lines.py: Wǒ juédé Bāxī duì gèng hǎo yìxiē.
lines.zh: 我觉得巴西队更好一些。
lines.rw: Ndatekereza ko ikipe ya Brazil ariyo nziza.

lines.py: Míngtiān wǒ yào cānjiā xuéxiào de lánqiú bǐsài.
lines.zh: 明天我要参加学校的篮球比赛。
lines.rw: Ejo nzakina mu ikipe ya basketball y’ishuri..
lines.en: Tomorrow I will take part in the school basketball match.

lines.py: Nǐ kěyǐ chuān nàshuāng xīn lánqiú xié.
lines.zh: 你可以穿那双新篮球鞋。
lines.rw: Ushobora kuzambara inkweto zawe nshya za basketball.
lines.en: You can wear your new sneakers.
When will the match begin tomorrow?

lines.py: Hǎo de. Wǒ zuòzuo zhǔnbèi huódòng.
lines.rw: Yego. Reka nkore imyitozo yo kwishyushya.
lines.en: Ok. Let me do some warming-up exercises.

lines.rw: Ejo ndashaka gutira ikibuga cya tenisi.
lines.en: I'd like to book a tennis court for tomorrow.

lines.py: Xiàwǔ sān diǎn dào wǔ diǎn.
lines.rw: Kuva saa cyenda kugeza saa kumi n’imwe.

lines.en: How many people are you in total?

lines.py: Bié wàng le dài wǎngqiú pāi.
lines.en: Don’t forget to bring your racket.

lines.py: Shì de, wǒ yìzhí jiānchí duànliàn shēntǐ.
lines.zh: 是的，我一直坚持锻炼身体。

lines.en: Do you often go to gym?
I go to gym every day.

lines.py: Nǐ duōcháng shíjiān duànliàn yí cì?
Wǒ píngshí gōngzuò hěn máng, jīhū méiyǒu shíjiān duànliàn.
lines.zh: 我平时工作很忙，几乎没有时间锻炼。
lines.rw: Buri gihe mba mfite akazi kenshi. Mu by’ukuri nta mwanya mbona wo gukora imyitozo ngororamubiri.
lines.en: I am always busy. I don’t really have time to exercise.

lines.py: Wǒ xiǎng jiǎnféi, shénme fāngfǎ zuì yǒuxiào?
lines.zh: 我想减肥，什么方法最有效？
lines.rw: Ndifuza kugabanya ibiro. Ni ubuhe buryo bwiza nakoresha?
lines.en: I want to lose weight. Which method do you think works best?

lines.py: Zǎoshang kōngqì zhēn hǎo, wǒmen qù sànsan bù ba.
lines.zh: 早上空气真好，我们去散散步吧。
lines.rw: Ikirere kirasa neza muri iki gitondo! Reka tujyane gutembera.
lines.en: The air is so fresh in the morning! Let’s go for a walk.

lines.py: Hǎo ya. Wǒmen qù pǎobù ba, zǎochén pǎobù duì shēntǐ yǒu hǎochù.
lines.zh: 好呀。我们去跑步吧，早晨跑步对身体有好处。
lines.rw: Yego. Reka tujye gukora jogingi. Jogingi mu gitondo ni nziza ku buzima.
lines.en: Ok. Let go jogging. Jogging in the morning is good for health.

lines.py: Wǒ yǒudiǎnr pǎo bú dòng le.
lines.en: I am afraid I can’t go any further,

lines.py: Sān cùn zhī shé, qiáng yú bǎiwàn zhī shī.
lines.zh: 三寸之舌，强于百万之师。
lines.en: The sharpness of the tongue defeats the sharpness of the warriors.

lines.py: Rén bùkě màoxiàng, hǎishuǐ bùkě dǒuliáng.
lines.zh: 人不可貌相，海水不可斗量。
lines.en: A name is just a name.

lines.py: Bú rù hǔ xué, yān dé hǔ zǐ.
Zhǐyào gōngfu shēn, tiěchǔ mó chéng zhēn.
lines.zh: 只要功夫深，铁杵磨成针。
lines.en: There is no pregnancy that isn't useful.

lines.py: Yuǎn qīn bù rú jìn lín.
lines.rw: Inshuti ya hafi ikurutira umuvandimwe wa kure.
lines.en: The other who is close is more important than a distant brother.

lines.py: Qiān lǐ zhī xíng, shǐ yú zú xià.
lines.en: Even a small hill makes us higher.

lines.py: Rén xīn bù zú shé tūn xiàng.
lines.en: Once a need is satisfied, another arises.

lines.py: Qiú rén bù rú qiú jǐ.
lines.en: The best place to find a helping hand is at the end of your own arm.
